package smb

import (
	"errors"
	"syscall"
	"testing"

	"github.com/codetreker/remote-fs/packages/storage"
)

func TestGateMissingStatusRequiresVerifiedParent(t *testing.T) {
	session, _, _, parent, _ := newClientTestSession(t)
	parent.entries = nil
	_, err := session.Open(t.Context(), clientTestOpenRequest(), clientTestAction(t))
	if _, ok := err.(*verifiedMissingNameError); !ok || !errors.Is(err, syscall.ENOENT) {
		t.Fatalf("verified absence: %T %v", err, err)
	}
	if len(parent.checks) != 1 || len(parent.lists) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("absence did not verify the parent observation")
	}
	for _, failure := range []error{syscall.EACCES, syscall.EIO, syscall.ESTALE} {
		t.Run(failure.Error(), func(t *testing.T) {
			session, _, _, parent, _ := newClientTestSession(t)
			parent.entries = nil
			parent.checkErr = failure
			_, err := session.Open(t.Context(), clientTestOpenRequest(), clientTestAction(t))
			if _, ok := err.(*verifiedMissingNameError); ok || !errors.Is(err, failure) {
				t.Fatalf("unverified parent mislabeled: %T %v", err, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestGateMissingStatusOnlyChangesFinalCreate(t *testing.T) {
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name, path string
		failure    error
		want       uint32
	}{
		{"final", "leaf", &verifiedMissingNameError{}, 0xc000000f},
		{"intermediate", "absent\\leaf", &verifiedMissingNameError{}, 0xc0000034},
		{"ordinary_enoent", "leaf", syscall.ENOENT, 0xc0000034},
		{"denied", "leaf", syscall.EACCES, 0xc0000022},
		{"unknown", "leaf", errors.Join(&verifiedMissingNameError{}, syscall.EIO), fileIOError},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			dispatcher, root, session, _ := commandDispatcher()
			root.attr.Attr.ID = 1
			root.attr.Attr.Kind = storage.NodeDirectory
			session.open = func(request windowsOpenRequest) (windowsOpenResult, error) {
				if request.Lookup.ParentID == 0 {
					return windowsOpenResult{File: root, Attr: root.attr}, nil
				}
				return windowsOpenResult{}, test.failure
			}
			_, status := dispatcher.create(t.Context(), createCommand(test.path, 1, 1))
			if status != test.want {
				t.Fatalf("status=%08x want=%08x", status, test.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
